businesses.business: turf and landscape equipment, and underground construction equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment, landscape and residential yard equipment, snow removal products, irrigation systems, and underground construction equipment. Sells to professional landscapers, golf courses, sports fields, contractors, municipalities and homeowners through dealers, distributors and retailers.

primary_products.value: mowers; golf course and grounds maintenance equipment; irrigation systems; underground utility construction equipment; snow throwers

customer_segment.value: B2B: professional landscape contractors, golf courses, rental companies, underground construction contractors, agriculture operators; B2C: homeowners buying residential mowers, snow throwers and yard tools; B2G: municipalities, parks and school districts buying grounds maintenance equipment

end_markets.value: landscaping; golf and sports turf; residential lawn care; underground utility construction; agriculture irrigation

revenue_model.value: product sales: equipment, irrigation products, parts and accessories sold to dealers, distributors, retailers and customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds equipment from purchased components and materials, sold to dealers, distributors, retailers and contractors; brand owner: markets branded equipment and parts across professional and residential lines

geography_served.value: global: North America is the largest market, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: turf equipment, residential yard products, underground construction equipment, irrigation and snow removal

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealers and distributors for professional equipment; third-party retail: home centers and mass retailers for residential products; online: online retailers and direct web sales of residential products; direct sales: some direct sales to large accounts and rental companies
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engine emissions rules (EPA, CARB), product safety (CPSC), and trade and tariff rules
